# FrontDoor

> FrontDoor builds done-for-you websites for behavioral health practices. Pick a design made for your kind of practice; we write it, build it and look after it, so you can focus on your clients. A service of iTrust Insights.

## Pages
- [Home](https://palace1997.github.io/frontdoor/): what FrontDoor is, how it works, and how to get started
- [Designs](https://palace1997.github.io/frontdoor/gallery.html): browse website designs by practice area and practice size
- [Privacy](https://palace1997.github.io/frontdoor/privacy.html): what this site collects, why, and how to ask for deletion

## Who it serves
- Behavioral and mental health practices: psychiatry, psychology, counseling and psychotherapy, marriage and family therapy, clinical social work, ABA, peer recovery, addiction and substance use, clinics, programs and organizations
- Solo practices, group practices, and programs, whether just starting out or already established

## Good to know
- Every design includes the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline in the footer
- Contact forms never ask for client or health information
